# PathStyleExtension

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Style a path (used with PathLayer, PolygonLayer, and GeoJSONLayer).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/path-style-extension",
  "type": "PathStyleExtensionOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/path-style-extension').par.dash` (an input) and `op('/path-style-extension').out.extension` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.dash`, `out.extension`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `dash` | `BooleanField` | `true` |
| `highPrecisionDash` | `BooleanField` | `false` |
| `offset` | `BooleanField` | `false` |
| `dashMode` | `StringLiteralField` | `"segment"` |
| `dashJustified` | `BooleanField` | `false` |
| `dashUnits` | `StringLiteralField` | `"widths"` |
| `getDashArray` | `Vec2Field` | `[4,4]` |
| `getOffset` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `dashGapPickable` | `BooleanField` | `false` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `extension` | `ExtensionField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
